messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: We used automatic late fees in Classic. Where's the setting now?

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: Automatic late fees were part of InvoicePilot Classic (1.x) and weren't carried over to 2.x. You can add a late fee as a line item or a separate invoice, and mention your terms in payment reminders.
